assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single premium slot-game symbol concept for THE GATES.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: copy its chunky hand-drawn cartoon finish, glossy warm yellow-gold bevels, orange shaded edges, very dark navy outlines, strong white painted highlights, cyan/royal-blue faceted gem. Do not copy the flower shape.
Primary request: ROYAL GATEKEEPER. A friendly expressive golden guardian face/mask wearing a compact royal gold crown with ONE prominent cyan diamond-shaped gem centered on the forehead. A magical palace guardian, not Egyptian. Warm confident smile, large readable blue eyes, two separate visible eyebrows, polished golden cheeks. Crown should frame the face elegantly with small rounded side flourishes; the entire silhouette is compact, nearly square, front-facing, bilaterally balanced, recognizable at 100px.
Style: polished flat illustrated cartoon game icon with dimensional painted shading, NOT realistic metal, not detailed 3D render. Match supplied Wild's rendering and bold outlines closely.
Composition: one fully visible isolated icon, centered, fills 80–85% of square canvas with ample transparent padding around crown. Truly transparent background. No rectangular card/frame, scenery, captions, letters or watermark.
Avoid: Egyptian striped nemes/headdress, pharaoh beard, hieroglyphics, Tutankhamun imagery, photoreal skin, angry or sinister face, extraneous neck/torso, thin filigree, different colored jewels, floating sparkle clouds. Crown and blue gem are part of the actual mask design. Finished still concept, not an animation sheet.

No text, cards, captions, watermark, backdrop or particles.

assets.cleanupPrompt: Edit this chalice concept ONLY to clean the background. Preserve the exact cup design, silhouette, color palette, handles, blue enamel, central cyan diamond gem, painted highlights, proportions and sharp navy outlines. Remove ALL gray haze, gray patches, shadow clouds, glow clouds and stray colored fringe outside the solid cup silhouette, including inside the open spaces of the handles. Outside the actual cup must be fully transparent clean alpha, with only natural 1–2px antialiasing directly at the outline. Keep the cyan interior illumination strictly inside the bowl opening. No ground shadow, no exterior aura, no smoke, no scenery. Do not redesign, add, remove or move any part of the goblet. Isolated clean cartoon slot symbol on true transparent background.
